title: Scammers Target Gift Cards
description: There's a warning for anyone who has received a gift card for Christmas. Laura Podesta reports.

asr.full_text: GIFT CARDS ARE ONE OF THE MOST POPULAR PRESENTS DURING THE HOLIDAYS. BUT CRIMINALS HAVE FIGURED OUT HOW TO USE THE CARDS BEFORE YOU DO. MADELINE O'CLOCK, VOTER IT WAS ACTUALLY A GIFT FROM MY SISTER. LAST YEAR, ALEX STEPHENSON TOLD US HOW A TWO HUNDRED DOLLAR BESPIED GIFT CARDS SHE RECEIVED CAME UP WITH A ZERO BALANCE WHEN SHE TRIED TO USE IT. ALEX STEPHENSON, VOTER IT WAS REJECTING THE CARD, AND HE DIDN'T UNDERSTAND WHY. THE SCAM HAS BEEN AROUND FOR YEARS, CRIMINALS COPY NUMBERS OFF OF GIFT CARDS ON PUBLIC DISPLAYS. THEY SCRATCH OFF THE PANELS ON THE BACKS TO GET THE SECURITY CODE, AND THEN PUT THEM BACK ON THE BACK OF THE CARDS. AND THEM GO TO DEVILS TO DEVIL, WELL, FOR CAUSED THEM OUT OF BALANCE ON THEIR SPACE. THE SCAM HAS security tickets, I don't understand why. The scam has been around for years. Criminals copy numbers off gift cards on public displays. They scratch off the panels to get the security codes and put them back on the rack. Once the card is bought and activated, they drain the balance. They even use zepara stickers that cover up scratched-off security panels, so suppliers don't realize the cards have been tampered with. Crooks also get numbers through security breaches by hacking into stores gift card databases. But there are ways to protect yourself. Make sure it has good packaging so you can't see the account number without opening the packaging. Jeff from consumer reports says stores are taking steps to protect the cards, like using more secure packaging and placing them behind the counter. Though he recommends purchasing them online directly from the retailer. If you do receive a card that's been drained, go back to the retailer and say you want your money back. When Alex contacted Best Buy, they gave her a new $200 card. Laura Podesta, CBS News New York. Consumer reports says gift card companies now have computer defense systems that can EQUIPMENT PROVIDED BY THE CYCLE. THE CAPABILITY FOR THE GIFT CARD IS USED TO IDENTIFY ONE IN THE PARTICULAR DOLLAR CARD. LAURA PEDESTA,CBS NEWS, NEW YORK.

textual.context: Explicit news warning and reporting context; the conduct is attributed to criminals or crooks, and the segment also discusses protective measures. No specific viewer transaction is shown in these records.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links access to gift-card numbers or security codes with a later transfer or loss of the card balance, creating a concrete mechanism for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that a particular person or organization carried out the described conduct, nor do they independently verify any transaction, database access, or viewer loss.

visual.observation: A news segment about gift card scams shows a retail gift card with its card number, PIN area, and barcode visible, alongside a warning reading "DO NOT BUY IF CODE IS REVEALED."
visual.context: Visible consumer-news and warning context; the instruction is presented as advice about inspecting a gift card before purchase.
visual.potential_relevance: The segment explicitly links the condition of a revealed gift-card code to the requested purchase decision, and the visible code/PIN provides a concrete gift-card credential exposure cue.
visual.limitations: These sampled frames do not establish who revealed the code, whether any code was used or transferred, whether a scam occurred, or what the surrounding narration says.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material is framed as a warning with prevention and remediation guidance rather than as an offer or endorsement.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it reports on gift-card tampering and gives viewers protective guidance. It describes criminals copying card numbers and security codes as reported scam methods, while the instruction to avoid cards with revealed codes is consumer-safety advice rather than a solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary theme is an anti-scam consumer warning: the narration reports alleged criminal gift-card tampering and balance draining, and provides protective and refund guidance. The footage also visibly presents the topic as gift-card scams and warns viewers not to buy a card if its code is revealed.
